description: The bar chart, titled "Recall@10," displays the performance of different methods in terms of recall at position 10, with the y-axis representing the recall value ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 on a linear scale. The x-axis lists four categories: "Ours," "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking." The bar for "Ours" is colored orange and has the highest value, approximately 0.37. The bars for "- critiquing," "- scoring," and "- ranking" are all colored blue, with values of approximately 0.33, 0.24, and 0.35, respectively. The chart shows that the "Ours" method achieves the highest Recall@10 score compared to the other three methods.
